_comment: Stonetavern Launcher UI strings. English is the SOURCE language (VOICE.md): no em dashes, no en dashes, no apostrophes. Every other catalog mirrors these keys exactly - LocalizationCatalogTests enforces that. Placeholders {0} {1} keep their meaning and order.
Splash_Status_UpdatingLauncher: Installing an update. The launcher will restart in a moment.
Play_Status_BringYourOwn: No download is offered for {0} on this realm. Point the launcher at a copy that is already on this computer.
Play_Status_Paused: Paused. Resume to continue where you stopped.
Play_Sub_NoClient: Download the {0} client straight from our server.
Play_Sub_BringYourOwn: Install the {0} client yourself, then Play will find it. This launcher cannot download or repair it for you.
Play_Sub_EraTransition: {0} needs the {1} client. Your old client stays where it is.
Play_Detail_Reconnecting: Connection lost. Reconnecting in {0}s (attempt {1} of {2}). Nothing downloaded so far is lost.
Play_Detail_TakingStock: Checking what is already on disk…
Play_Detail_RepairFoundDefects: {0} damaged file(s) found. Downloading a fresh client.
Play_Error_NoSha: The server manifest is incomplete (no SHA256). Please tell the operator.
Play_Error_GameRunning: WoW is running. Please close the game, then try again.
Play_Error_InstallDirNotWritable: The install folder cannot be written to. Choose a different folder in Settings.
Play_Error_NoDiskSpace: Not enough free disk space for this download. Free up space or choose a different install folder in Settings.
Play_Error_WineNotPersistent: The client started but did not keep running (Wine). Please check your Wine installation and the client. Details are in the log.
Play_LauncherUpdateHint: Launcher version {0} is available. Download at {1}
Play_Language_LocalOnly: This realm offers no language downloads.
Play_Locate_Title: Choose your World of Warcraft folder
Play_Locate_NotFound: No World of Warcraft client was found in that folder. Choose the folder that holds WoW.exe or WowClassic.exe.
Play_Locate_WrongClient: That folder holds a client for a different game version than this realm needs. Choose the client that matches this realm.
Download_Fail_Network: No connection. Check your internet. Nothing was overwritten.
Download_Fail_Server: Our server is not answering right now. Please try again later.
Download_Fail_Disk: Writing to disk failed. Check free space and permissions.
Download_Fail_Hash: The checksum does not match. The file was discarded, so nothing is at risk. Please try again.
Settings_Client_A11y: Choose the client build for this realm
Settings_Client_Hint: The launcher writes realmlist.wtf into the install for this build, so keep it matched to what the server runs.
Settings_BothClients: Offer both clients on this realm
Settings_BothClients_A11y: Whether this realm offers both game clients
Settings_BothClients_Hint: Turn this on if the server accepts 1.12.1 and 1.14.2. The switch above the play button then lets you pick, and you do not need a second entry for the same address.
Settings_Error_BadAddress: That realmlist address cannot be used. Enter a hostname or an IP, with no spaces and no line breaks.
Settings_Error_BadManifestUrl: That manifest URL cannot be used. Enter a full address that starts with https://, or leave the field empty. Plain http:// is only accepted for localhost or a 127.0.0.1 address.
Settings_Error_SaveFailed: Settings could not be written to disk. Nothing was lost, but changes will be gone once you close the launcher. Check that the launcher folder is writable.
Settings_RealmsElsewhere: Realms live on the rail on the left. The lantern is a realm, the plus opens their management.
Settings_InstallFolder_Hint: Leave empty to let the launcher pick a location. New client downloads go in a sub-folder here, one per game version.
V2_Notes_Sub: News and patches from the realm
V2_Options_Hint: Changes take effect on the next start
Settings_ProfileSync: Keep my realms with my account
Settings_ProfileSync_Hint: Sign in on another machine and the realms you added come back. Only the realms travel: names, addresses and which client they need. Install folders and paths stay on this machine. Off unless you turn it on.
Settings_Runtime_A11y: Which Wine the game is started with
Settings_Runtime_AutoWineGe: In use: {0}. Picked automatically, because a wine-ge runner is installed.
Settings_Runtime_AutoSystem: In use: {0}. Picked automatically, because there is no wine-ge runner.
Settings_Runtime_WineGeMissing: No wine-ge runner is installed. Using {0} instead.
Settings_Runtime_CustomMissing: That file cannot be run. Using {0} instead.
Settings_Runtime_None: No Wine was found on this system. The game cannot start until one is installed.
Settings_Runtime_Hint: Leave this on Automatic unless the game does not start. A Proton build has no entry of its own: choose Custom path and point it at the wine binary inside that build.
Settings_Release_UpToDate: You have {0}, which is what the update server offers.
Settings_Release_Behind: You have {0}. The update server offers {1}. Get it at {2}.
Settings_Release_Ahead: You have {0}, which is newer than the {1} the update server offers. Nothing to do.
Settings_Release_Never: This launcher has never reached the update server. You have {0}.
Settings_Release_NoOffer: You have {0}. The update server named no launcher version.
Settings_Release_CheckedStale: Last successful check: {0} days ago, so the line above may be out of date.
Settings_Release_CheckedNever: There has never been a successful check on this machine.
Settings_StartReport_Hint: Copy this into your question when you ask for help. It lists the client, the realm address, the addon set and the Wine the launcher would start the game with. It stays on this machine until you paste it, and it contains no password and no log.
Settings_StartReport_Copy_A11y: Copy the start report to the clipboard
Settings_StartReport_Copied: Copied. Paste it where you are asking.
Settings_StartReport_Failed: The clipboard refused. Select the text above and copy it by hand.
Settings_DesktopIntegration_Hint: Add the launcher to your applications menu, with its own icon in the menu and in the taskbar. Nothing is written until you press the button.
Settings_AddToMenu_A11y: Add the launcher to your applications menu
Settings_AddToMenu_Failed: Could not add the menu entry. Your home folder may be read only.
V3_Account_SignedOutLead: Sign in with your Stonetavern account to see who is online and to look up your characters. Playing does not need it.
V3_Account_FriendsHint: Your friends list lives in the panel on the right. Signing in opens it.
V3_Friends_SignInPrompt: Sign in to see who is online.
V3_AddRealm_UpdateSource_Hint: If the realm operator gives you one, the launcher can then download and repair its client for you. Without it you keep your own client up to date, and Play only points at what you already have installed.
V3_ClientToggle_A11y: Choose which client to play with
V3_NoAccounts: No accounts on your list yet.
Login_Forgot_A11y: Reset your password on the website
Login_Forgot_OpenFailed: Open {0} in your browser to reset your password.
Login_Error_RateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
Login_Error_Unavailable: The login service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
Login_Error_Generic: Could not sign in right now. Please try again shortly.
Login_Error_BadResponse: The server response could not be read. Please try again.
Login_Error_Network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Login_Error_Timeout: The server did not answer in time. You are not signed in and nothing was changed, please try again.
Friends_Error_Duplicate: That account is already on your list.
Friends_Error_AddFailed: Could not add that account. Please try again.
Friends_Error_Network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Friends_Error_Timeout: The server did not answer in time. The request may not have gone through, please try again in a moment.
Armory_Empty_SignedOut: Sign in to see your characters.
Armory_Empty_NoCharacters: No characters on this realm yet.
Armory_Empty_Unavailable: Character data is not available right now.
Armory_Realm_SignedOut: {0}: sign in to see your characters
Register_Lead: One Stonetavern account for every realm.
Register_Error_Empty: Fill in every field to create your account.
Register_Error_Rules: Please accept the server rules to continue.
Register_Error_Mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
Register_Error_Conflict: That account name is taken, or this email already has too many accounts.
Register_Error_RateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
Register_Error_Unavailable: The account service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
Register_Error_Invalid: Please check your details. Your password must be long enough and your email must be valid.
Register_Error_Generic: Could not create your account right now. Please try again shortly.
Register_Error_BadResponse: The server response could not be read. Please try again.
Register_Error_Network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Register_Error_Timeout: The server did not answer in time. Your account was not created, please try again.
Close_Prompt_Title: Keep Stonetavern running in the background?
Close_Prompt_Body: It stays in the system tray so your friends list and downloads keep working. You can bring it back any time from the tray icon.
Addons_Intro: Addons are community made. The realm mirrors these copies, so what you install is what everyone else here runs.
Addons_State_Foreign: Already in your AddOns folder. The launcher did not put it there, so it leaves it alone.
Addons_LoadFailed: The addon list could not be loaded.
Addons_Empty: No addons are offered for this client yet.
Addons_NeedsClient: Install or locate the game client first. Addons live inside the client folder.
Addons_SignedOut_Lead: Sign in to see the addon catalogue. It is the same account you play with.
Addons_SignedOut_Keep: Addons you already installed stay where they are and keep working.
Addons_SignedOut_Button_A11y: Go to the account page to sign in
Addons_Profile_Hint: Elwynn and Barrens share one game folder, so each realm keeps its own set of addons. Switching here swaps which set the game loads. Nothing is deleted, and the other set is waiting where you left it.
Addons_NewSet_A11y: Name for a new addon set
Addons_NewSet_Created: {0} is now the active set. It starts empty.
Addons_NewSet_Exists: There is already a set with that name.
Addons_NewSet_Hint: A new set starts empty and becomes the active one. Nothing is copied and nothing is deleted, so the set you are on now is waiting where you left it.
Addons_Profile_Failed: The addon set could not be switched.
Play_ReportProblem_A11y: Report a problem with the launcher
Report_Body: Tell us what happened. The launcher attaches its own version, your system and the last lines of its log, so you do not have to find any of that yourself.
Report_Message_Hint: What did you do, and what happened instead?
Report_Contact_Hint: Email or Discord name, if you want an answer
Report_Sent_Body: Thank you. Your report is on its way. Keep this reference if you want to follow it up:
Report_Failed_Generic: The report could not be sent. Please try again later.
Language_Failed: The language could not be switched
Language_Update_A11y: Download the newer language pack and replace the installed one
Armory_ScopeNote: These are the characters on your Stonetavern realms. Characters on any other server are not shown here.
Armory_Join_Lead: You need a Stonetavern account to play here. The same account signs you into this launcher and into the game itself, so there is only one to remember.
Play_Locate_Hint: Already have the game files on this machine? Point the launcher at the folder instead of downloading them again.
Play_AddonSet_A11y: Which addon set the game loads
Play_AddonSet_Hint: You choose the realm inside the game, so the launcher cannot pick this for you. Set it here before you play.
Settings_LocateClient_Hint: If the game files are already on this machine, point the launcher at the folder instead of downloading them again.
Settings_LocateClient_Done: A client is already registered for this realm. To pick a different folder, use the button on the play page.
